It takes a lot of courage to recognize this change in yourself and want a healthier environment for your daughters. It is very common to absorb the emotional climate of our surroundings. Living with a partner who struggles with intense rage can put your own nervous system on high alert, making you feel constantly on edge and quick to react. You are not a bad mother for struggling with this; the fact that you want to find your way back to your old self shows how much you care.

Speaking with a mental health professional could be incredibly helpful. A therapist can teach you grounding techniques to manage your anger in the moment and help you navigate the stress of your home environment. Because you mentioned your partner's rage gets very bad, please remember that your well-being is paramount. If you ever feel unsafe or overwhelmed, please reach out to the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE or text "START" to 88788. You and your babies deserve a peaceful home.
